code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The vertical 2-line is the anchor. Move the non-background object
    # immediately to its right and add an 8 stripe on the far side.
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    cells = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if c > divider and grid[r][c] != bg]
    left = min(c for r,c,v in cells); right=max(c for r,c,v in cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(divider+1,w): out[r][c]=bg
    shift=divider+1-left
    for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c+shift]=v
    edge=right+shift+1
    if edge < w:
        for r in range(h):
            if any(rr==r for rr,cc,v in cells): out[r][edge]=8
    return out
'''
